label: GO step after an unrewarded trial, early in the episode
explanation: Fires only at GO steps (never D1/D2), and almost only when the previous trial was unrewarded (99.7% of mass at prev_reward==0; zero on rewarded-input steps). It is strongly confined to the first ~40-50 trials of an episode (rate 22% at ep_trial 1-2, falling to ~0 after trial 50), so it acts like an early-episode / not-yet-settled no-reward signal. GO & prev_reward==0 & ep_trial<40 covers ~98% of activation mass but precision is only ~0.38: most such steps stay silent. Within that set it fires more, and larger, when the unrewarded state was S2 (prev_state==2: 73% of mass) and when the unrewarded transition was common (common-unrewarded, the model-based switch case: precision rises to 0.63 but recall falls to 0.62); it is weak after an unrewarded S1 visit. Higher rates soon after a reversal and on switch trials / chose_good==0. Recorded the simpler high-mass predicate; it uses only observed variables.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over last trial (GO: a2 S2 u, a1 S2 u, a1 S1 u) and trial before (GO: ?, a1 S2 r, a2 S1 r); timing cues that raise it most: phase=GO & ep_dec=0, phase=GO & ep_dec=1, phase=GO & ep_dec=2.
